== Summary ==
Defending Star Trek CCG champion Bill Chien of Shawnee Mission, Kansas in a relaxed and easygoing mood. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
